scenario_description: Resist order changes, lexical bridges, invalid minima, and large distractor corpora.
expected: Reordering the same corpus does not change the exact selected source set.
Bridge and negated distractors are excluded from every answered source set.
Partial or contract-invalid requests produce clean abstention without claims or sources.
Source minima of one, three, and six select only the permitted evidence community.
The 200-document case selects twenty permitted sources within eight seconds.
Every output satisfies the public contract and every citation quote is exactly grounded.
Every container cleanup command succeeds and no probe container remains.
observed: Both policy permutations selected the same exact five-source set.
Lexical-bridge and negated-near-duplicate cases selected only the permitted calibration and release sources.
Partial evidence, boolean minimum_sources, and duplicate document identities produced clean abstention.
Minimum-source cases one, three, and six selected only custody evidence and met the requested counts.
The 200-document case selected twenty seismic sources in 0.432 seconds in the bounded container.
All 162 checks matched, every output contract and exact citation check passed, all cleanup exits were zero, and no probe container remained.
notes: Manual review compared all eleven raw requests, stdout artifacts, selected identities, citations, schema and typed-contract classifications, duration limits, and cleanup evidence. The suite is deterministic adversarial remediation evidence, not a blinded holdout or universal semantic claim.
